items.title: IREDA’s Q1 Revenue Up 15% on Higher Loan Interest Accruals
items.summary: Government-owned lender Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) posted a revenue from operations of ₹22.5 billion (~$235.2 million) in the first quarter (Q1) of the financial year (FY) 2027, up 15% year-over-year (YoY) compared with ₹19.48 billion (~$203.6 million).Interest income, which comprised the largest share of revenue, rose 15.2% YoY to ₹21.99 billion (~$229.8 million) from ₹19.

items.title: Coal India Seeks ₹7 Billion Term Loan for 750 MWh Battery Storage Project
items.summary: Coal India (CIL) has invited bids for a rupee term loan of ₹7.134 billion (~$74.55 million) to develop a 187.5 MW/750 MWh standalone battery energy storage system (BESS) project in Choutuppal, Telangana. items.title: India buys its most expensive LNG in years as war upends market
items.summary: Indian energy companies are paying more than $23 per mmbtu for September LNG cargoes, among the highest prices for imports since 2022, as the Iran war disrupts global supplies. GAIL India and Gujarat State Petroleum Corp. have bought cargoes at these levels, while Bharat Petroleum has also purchased LNG from the spot market.
